C1455.title: Aztec Connect Legacy Contract Vulnerability Exploited for $2.1 Million
C1455.summary: In mid-June 2026, an old Aztec Connect contract was exploited, with a verification mismatch in the old contract leading to more than 2.1 million US dollars being drained or lost. Because the old code was not upgradeable and lacked effective blocking mechanisms, the incident exposed risks in decommissioning, migration, and governance response for privacy protocols and immutable contracts. It should not be described as tokens being stranded and impossible to withdraw unless a supporting source is added.
